text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In the racing history I have yearned for 
and pursued, I want to leave my own 
hoofprints—to carve out the most thrilling 
drama... That is my dream.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
With the "Genesis Method" I've built up, I 
will definitely make it come true...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
